title: Slovakian Pepper Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with sweet peppers and a hint of Slovakian spice. Perfect for a cozy dinner night.
instructions: Chop the onion and sauté it in olive oil until softened.
Add the garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the sweet and red peppers, and sauté until tender.
Add the Slovakian paprika and stir for 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, combine the chopped yellow peppers and the casserole.
Add the pepper mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional peppers if desired.
Uncover and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the casserole is golden brown.
